subject.title: test(repair): add hermetic automerge end-to-end flow

question: Should this repository accept the externally published `masonxhuang` executable base image for the automerge validation harness, or require a repository-controlled build and provenance path before merge?
rationale: Choosing which image publisher, registry, attestation model, and CI build path are acceptable supply-chain boundaries is maintainer policy, not a mechanical patch choice.

options.title: Build and attest repository-owned image
options.body: Build the reviewed base Dockerfile under a repository-controlled workflow or registry and have CI run the container harness from that provenance.

options.title: Accept the external pinned image
options.body: Explicitly document the trusted publisher and review the immutable image provenance before retaining the Docker Hub dependency.

options.title: Keep direct-harness coverage only
options.body: Remove the container claim and defer the container wrapper until a maintained image-publication path exists.

recommendation.title: Build and attest repository-owned image
recommendation.body: Build the reviewed base Dockerfile under a repository-controlled workflow or registry and have CI run the container harness from that provenance.

likelyOwner.reason: The Docker Hub namespace embedded in the proposed executable base image is the clearest available provenance contact.
